headline: Handcrafted in Florence, made to order to cut waste
body: Skip mass production. Our Tuscan workshop crafts your custom leather bag in small batches using traceable Italian hides. Shipped directly from Florence in zero plastic packaging.
rationale: This persona requires specific sustainability claims and supply chain transparency to overcome skepticism about luxury goods. Highlighting the made-to-order, small-batch Tuscan workshop model directly addresses their ethical footprint concerns while explicitly avoiding vague eco claims and excessive packaging.
